messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: PagerDuty: high latency alert fired for route= /v1/inference.generate (eu-west). p99=2.6s (>SLO 1.5s). Trigger: latency-p99-breach. PD incident #INC1757772468.
sara_oncall: acked the PD incident, oncall taking initial triage. seeing p95 also creeping ~1.2s. any recent rollouts?
lee_sre: no prod deploys in last 2 hours. checking autoscaler logs and kv-cache eviction metrics now. possible cache thrash on embedding-store?
ops-bot: PagerDuty status: acknowledged by sara_oncall. escalation timer paused.
mike_eng: looking at runtime metrics — there are a bunch of long tail token generation spikes from model-v2-48q on host group eu-west-a. KV cache hit rate dropped ~30% at 12:34 UTC.
sara_oncall: can we temporarily fail traffic to model-v2-48q to model-v2-32q or route to dedicated pool? need quick mitigation if cache warmup will take minutes.
lee_sre: prepping a routing policy flip. if we reroute 20% -> dedicated it should reduce p99 quickly. planning: add route override + reduce batch window for that pool.
nana_support: (typo) ana_support: getting initial customer reports — 3 tickets flagged high latency from EU customers, internal dashboard shows spike in errors-retries for two major customers. tagging account teams.
mike_eng: quick command to set traffic override (will run if approved):
```
POST /controlplane/v1/routes/override
{
  "route": "/v1/inference.generate",
  "target_model": "model-v2-32q",
  "percent": 20,
  "reason": "p99 mitigation"
}
```
sara_oncall: go for it. mike_eng run the override and watch p99. i'll monitor PD and slack.
mike_eng: override applied. rolling out 20% -> model-v2-32q. watching metrics...
lee_sre: noticed immediate drop in p99 for that subset to ~1.1s. overall p99 trending down from 2.6 -> 1.8. still above SLO but improving.
nana_support: ana_support: customers notified via status page? Should we post a short incident update?
sara_oncall: yes create brief: "We are investigating elevated inference latency in EU region; traffic diverted to fallback models; mitigation in progress; no data loss." i'll post.
ops-bot: Incident note added to PD: mitigation applied (traffic override 20% -> model-v2-32q).
lee_sre: additional mitigation: reducing batch max_ms from 35 -> 15 for eu-west pools to reduce queueing for short requests. applying now.
mike_eng: batch window change applied. p99 now ~1.35s, p95 ~0.9s. still monitoring for KV warmup.
sara_oncall: handoff plan: i'm going offline in 30m, leaving to lee_sre for continued triage. lee, please escalate to carol (senior oncall) if p99 rises above 1.6s again.
lee_sre: will pick up. logging next steps: check eviction churn in redis kvx, examine hotspot hosts, consider rolling restart of model-v2-48q hosts if churn persists.
nana_support: ana_support: raising customer impact flag to "partial degradation" and linking open tickets. will coordinate status updates.
mike_eng: quick note: long-tail root cause hypothesis = periodic background compaction on storage node evicting large prefixes causing cache miss storms. adding metric alerts for eviction-rate spikes.
sara_oncall: thanks team. leaving handoff to lee_sre. PD incident remains acknowledged. will update post-mortem if root cause confirmed. :thumbsup:
ops-bot: PagerDuty: incident still in acknowledged state. Escalation timer set to 15m if condition recurs.
lee_sre: continuing monitoring, will post follow-ups here. any urgent vendor contact needed I'll ping infra-ops.
nana_support: ana_support: posted incident blurb to status.redwood.com and added affected customers list.
lee_sre: marking this thread for follow-up: add playbook entry for cache-eviction induced latency, include steps for temporary route override and batch-window adjustments.
mike_eng: noted. grabbing logs for postmortem — saving KV eviction traces and model host metrics.
lee_sre: last check p99=1.25s, p95=0.85s, error retries back to baseline. closing active mitigation; keeping watch for 1h.
sara_oncall: confirmed, good job. I'll file a short incident report later.
incident-bot: :white_check_mark: Incident #INC1757772468 annotated as 'mitigated' by sara_oncall.
